purpose: 입 없는 동일 개체의 독립 시험 자산. 앱 생성/저장과 별개.

prompts.leaf-sit:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: attached leaf baby pet. Create ONE transparent PNG animation pose asset for My-Jarvis. Preserve this exact individual, drawing style, palette, proportions, camera facing right in 3/4 view. Cream body, green broad leaf ears and leaf stem tail, green toe tips, brown eyes.
Change only the pose to SITTING: rump on floor, short forelegs upright together in front, small back feet tucked beside rump. Eyes open, comfortable curiosity.
Absolutely NO MOUTH and NO NOSE: lower face completely blank cream surface, no smile, dot, caret, crease or tiny dash between or beneath eyes. Exactly four short legs, only the established ears and tail; no new anatomy. Soft stylized volume, no photorealism. Center complete silhouette within square canvas with clear 8% empty margin on all sides; feet/contact near 88% canvas height. No text, no props, no background, no ground plane or cast shadow. True alpha transparency; no checkerboard painted into image. Single character only.
